location_rules.barcelona: allowed ONLY if the employing legal entity is non-Spanish
location_rules.europe_wider: allowed if the role is based anywhere else in Europe (not just Barcelona) AND the company plausibly supports hiring in the UK now with a later transfer to that office - an internal relocation with the same employer, not a Digital Nomad Visa arrangement. A posting for a specific office that gives no indication of entertaining 'hire in UK, move later' should be flagged for human confirmation, not assumed to support it or silently dropped.
location_rules.why: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires a NON-SPANISH employer. A Barcelona role employed via a Spanish entity breaks visa eligibility outright. If the entity isn't clear from the listing, flag it - never silently include or silently drop it. The europe_wider rule is a separate, later addition (31 Aug) - it runs alongside the Barcelona/DNV plan, not instead of it.

compensation_floor.rule: include if unstated; include if above floor; exclude only if a stated figure is clearly and substantially below it
compensation_floor.note: Left blank in the committed version - this is a real negotiating position, not something to publish. Set your own numbers in a local, uncommitted edit.

notes_for_editing: This file is the whole point of extending the agent without touching code. Add/remove sources, adjust the comp floor, or add new role titles here.
